# Tray { #anylumino.Tray }

```python
Tray(children=None, *, open=True, **kwargs)
```

Display child content in a tray surface.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type     | Description                                                            | Default   |
|----------|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| children | optional | Child anywidgets or keyed child mapping rendered inside the component. | `None`    |
| open     | optional | Whether an overlay-like component starts open.                         | `True`    |
